texts.orig: 4. Which of the following is the MOST cost-effective type of access control?
texts.text: Which of the following is the MOST cost-effective type of access control?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Centralized access control is not a type of access control but a form of administration.
texts.text: Centralized access control is not a type of access control but a form of administration.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Role-based access control allows users to be grouped into job-related categories, which significantly eases the required administrative overhead. In most enterprises there are fewer roles than employees, and roles change far less frequently.
texts.text: Role-based access control allows users to be grouped into job-related categories, which significantly eases the required administrative overhead. In most enterprises there are fewer roles than employees, and roles change far less frequently.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Decentralized access control is not a type of access control but an administrative approach.
texts.text: Decentralized access control is not a type of access control but an administrative approach.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Discretionary access control would require a greater degree of administrative overhead because it is based on each individual rather than on groups of individuals.
texts.text: Discretionary access control would require a greater degree of administrative overhead because it is based on each individual rather than on groups of individuals.
